name: Japan Electronic Materials Corporation
summary: Japan Electronic Materials Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductor inspection and electron tube parts in Japan, Asia, North America, and Europe. It provides cantilever type and advanced probe cards; heaters and cathodes for receiving tubes and CRTs; filaments for fluorescent character display tubes; and directly heated cathodes. The company also offers color TV displays, including high-definition TV, computer, measurement, and radar displays. In addition, it is involved in the processing and assembly of heat-resistant metals, such as tungsten and molybdenum.
